cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_BINARY_DIR)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "In-tree builds are not supported. Run CMake from a separate directory: cmake -B build")
endif()

set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT OFF)
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT ON)

	# Bootstrap cmkr and automatically regenerate CMakeLists.txt
	include(cmkr.cmake OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
	if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
		cmkr()
	endif()

	# Enable folder support
	set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY USE_FOLDERS ON)

	# Create a configure-time dependency on cmake.toml to improve IDE support
	configure_file(cmake.toml cmake.toml COPYONLY)
endif()

add_compile_options($<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/MP>)

project(MW5-UEVR-Plugins)

set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} /MP")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} /MP")

set(ASMJIT_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

if ("${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}" MATCHES "Release")
    set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} /MT")
    set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} /MT")

    # Statically compile runtime
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/MD" "/MT" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/MD" "/MT" CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/MD" "/MT" CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "/MD" "/MT" CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE}")

    message(NOTICE "Building in Release mode")
endif()

	"src/hud_display/ThreatAlarm.h"
	"src/hud_display/TopoView.h"
	"src/hud_display/Topo3DView.h"
	"src/hud_display/TerrainUnderlay.h"
	"include/LidarShared.h"
	"include/TerrainShared.h"
	"include/GlobalSettings.h"
	cmake.toml
)

add_executable(HUDDisplay)

source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${HUDDisplay_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(HUDDisplay PRIVATE
	"include/"
)

target_link_libraries(HUDDisplay PRIVATE
	winmm
)

get_directory_property(CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} DEFINITION VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
if(NOT CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
	set_property(DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT HUDDisplay)
endif()

# Target: GlobalSettings (2026-10-07f, added by hand to match cmake.toml): the settings window for
# GlobalSettings.ini (everything shared by every window and app). Direct2D / DirectWrite via #pragma comment.
set(GlobalSettings_SOURCES
	"src/global_settings/Main.cpp"
	"src/hud_display/ThreatAlarm.cpp"
	"src/common/PaperdollExtract.cpp"
	"src/common/PaperdollExtract.h"

	"include/GlobalSettings.h"
	"src/hud_display/ThreatAlarm.h"
	cmake.toml
)

	"include/"
	"ext/miniz/"
)

target_compile_features(GlobalSettings PRIVATE
	cxx_std_17
)

# 2026-10-13: the alarm TEST button plays through the threat alarm's own waveOut synthesiser
target_link_libraries(GlobalSettings PRIVATE
	winmm
)

# Target: VoiceCommand (added by hand to match cmake.toml: this build configures with CMKR_SKIP_GENERATION=ON)
set(VoiceCommand_SOURCES
	"src/voice_command/Main.cpp"
	"include/VanillaHudShared.h"
	"include/LidarShared.h"
	"include/LanceStatusShared.h"
	"include/GlobalSettings.h"
	cmake.toml
)

add_executable(VoiceCommand)

target_sources(VoiceCommand PRIVATE ${VoiceCommand_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${VoiceCommand_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(VoiceCommand PRIVATE
	"include/"
)

target_link_libraries(VoiceCommand PRIVATE
	ole32
	sapi
)

# Free speech (VoiceCommand stage 3): whisper.cpp built from a local checkout, CPU only, linked
# statically into VoiceCommand.exe. Point WHISPER_CPP_DIR elsewhere to move it; without it,
# VoiceCommand still builds (fixed phrases only).
set(WHISPER_CPP_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ext/whisper.cpp" CACHE PATH "whisper.cpp source (VoiceCommand free speech) - vendored in ext/ since the 2026-10-08 release prep")
if(EXISTS "${WHISPER_CPP_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
	set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW) # the options below win over whisper.cpp's defaults
	set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0091 NEW) # and it gets our static runtime (CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY), Debug too
	set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
	set(WHISPER_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
	set(WHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
	set(WHISPER_BUILD_SERVER OFF)
	set(GGML_CUDA OFF)
	set(GGML_OPENMP OFF) # its own thread pool: no OpenMP runtime DLL next to the exe
	# The CPU instruction set, fixed rather than detected: ggml's MSVC detection (GGML_NATIVE) ran
	# test programs the compiler reduces to "return 0", so it "found" AVX-512 on a CPU without it
	# (Ryzen 7 5800X3D) and the build died at start-up with an illegal instruction (0xC000001D).
	# AVX2 + FMA + F16C + BMI2: every Intel since Haswell (2013), every Ryzen.
	set(GGML_NATIVE OFF)
	set(GGML_AVX ON)
	set(GGML_AVX2 ON)
	set(GGML_FMA ON)
	set(GGML_F16C ON)
	set(GGML_BMI2 ON)
	set(GGML_AVX512 OFF)
	# 2026-10-14 (user): Whisper on the graphics card through Vulkan ([voice] whisper_gpu, off by default; the
	# round trip always uses it). Building it needs the Vulkan SDK (glslc + vulkan-1.lib, VULKAN_SDK set by its
	# installer - restart Visual Studio after installing); players need only their GPU driver. Without the SDK:
	# CPU only, as before. vulkan-1.dll is delay-loaded below, so the exe still starts without a Vulkan driver.
	option(VC_WHISPER_VULKAN "VoiceCommand: Whisper may use the graphics card (Vulkan SDK needed to build)" ON)
	set(GGML_VULKAN OFF)
	if(VC_WHISPER_VULKAN)
		find_package(Vulkan COMPONENTS glslc QUIET)
		if(Vulkan_FOUND AND Vulkan_glslc_FOUND)
			set(GGML_VULKAN ON)
		else()
			message(STATUS "VoiceCommand: Vulkan SDK not found - Whisper CPU only")
		endif()
	endif()
	# Optimised even in Debug builds (an unoptimised Whisper is 10x+ slower); the copies of these
	# flags whisper.cpp's directory takes are the only ones changed.
	set(VC_SAVED_C_DEBUG "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG}")
	set(VC_SAVED_CXX_DEBUG "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG}")
	if(MSVC)
		set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "/O2 /Ob2 /DNDEBUG")
		set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "/O2 /Ob2 /DNDEBUG")
	endif()
	add_subdirectory("${WHISPER_CPP_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/whisper.cpp" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
	set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "${VC_SAVED_C_DEBUG}")
	set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "${VC_SAVED_CXX_DEBUG}")
	unset(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS) # only for whisper.cpp
	target_link_libraries(VoiceCommand PRIVATE whisper)
	target_compile_definitions(VoiceCommand PRIVATE VC_HAVE_WHISPER=1)
	if(GGML_VULKAN)
		target_compile_definitions(VoiceCommand PRIVATE VC_HAVE_WHISPER_GPU=1)
		target_link_options(VoiceCommand PRIVATE "/DELAYLOAD:vulkan-1.dll")
		target_link_libraries(VoiceCommand PRIVATE delayimp)
		message(STATUS "VoiceCommand: Whisper GPU (Vulkan) built in")
	endif()
	message(STATUS "VoiceCommand: free speech with whisper.cpp from ${WHISPER_CPP_DIR}")
else()
	message(STATUS "VoiceCommand: whisper.cpp not found at ${WHISPER_CPP_DIR} - fixed phrases only")
endif()

# Kokoro voices (VoiceCommand): sherpa-onnx's SHARED package (win-x64-shared-MT-Release), kept in
# the project at ext/sherpa-onnx/ - c-api.h + sherpa-onnx-c-api.lib (import lib) + the DLLs, which
# are copied beside VoiceCommand.exe after each build. The shared package replaced the static one:
# linking every static .lib (onnxruntime & co.) failed when one (espeak-ng.lib) went missing. The
# Kokoro MODEL is not here - VoiceCommand.ini's kokoro_dir points at it (kokoro-82m/...).
# Without the package, VoiceCommand still builds (the Windows voices speak, radio filter included).
option(VC_KOKORO_TTS "VoiceCommand: Kokoro voices through sherpa-onnx" ON)
set(SHERPA_ONNX_PKG "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ext/sherpa-onnx/sherpa-onnx-v1.13.6-win-x64-shared-MT-Release" CACHE PATH "sherpa-onnx shared package (VoiceCommand Kokoro voices)")
if(VC_KOKORO_TTS AND EXISTS "${SHERPA_ONNX_PKG}/include/sherpa-onnx/c-api/c-api.h" AND EXISTS "${SHERPA_ONNX_PKG}/lib/sherpa-onnx-c-api.lib")
	target_include_directories(VoiceCommand PRIVATE "${SHERPA_ONNX_PKG}/include")
	target_link_libraries(VoiceCommand PRIVATE "${SHERPA_ONNX_PKG}/lib/sherpa-onnx-c-api.lib")
	target_compile_definitions(VoiceCommand PRIVATE VC_HAVE_TTS=1)
	foreach(dll sherpa-onnx-c-api.dll onnxruntime.dll onnxruntime_providers_shared.dll)
		add_custom_command(TARGET VoiceCommand POST_BUILD
			COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${SHERPA_ONNX_PKG}/lib/${dll}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:VoiceCommand>")
	endforeach()
	message(STATUS "VoiceCommand: Kokoro voices with sherpa-onnx from ${SHERPA_ONNX_PKG}")
else()
	message(STATUS "VoiceCommand: Kokoro voices off (VC_KOKORO_TTS=${VC_KOKORO_TTS}) or sherpa-onnx not found at ${SHERPA_ONNX_PKG} - the Windows voices speak")
endif()

set_target_properties(HUDDisplay PROPERTIES WIN32_EXECUTABLE TRUE)
